parole.significato: A group of Native Americans who reside primarily in the Sonoran Desert of southeastern Arizona and northwestern Mexico;…
parole.testo: From O'odham hia (“sand”) + -c'eḑ (“locative suffix”) + o'odham (“people”), thus "sand people".

parole.significato: A person of Tohono O'odham (formerly Papago), Akimel O'odham (formerly Pima), or other O'odham ancestry.

parole.testo: From O'odham t'pawi (“it is a bean”).
